articles.excerpt:
Indian equity benchmarks extended their losing streak for an eighth consecutive week, marking the Nifty 50’s longest weekly decline since 2001. Rising US 10-year Treasury yields, uncertainty over the US-Iran conflict and heightened volatility in Brent crude prices continued to weigh on investor sentiment.

Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) added to the pressure, selling equities worth ₹44,012.82 crore during the week, their highest weekly selling since June 2026. The Nifty 50 fell 3.1% during the holiday-shortened week, while the BSE Sensex declined 2.7%, taking its eight-week losses to 8.7% and 8.4%, respectively.

articles.title: Geojit Financial Services appoints Jones George as MD, founder C J George moves to Executive Chairman role
articles.excerpt:
Geojit Financial Services Limited on Wednesday announced a leadership transition, appointing founder C J George as Executive Chairman and Jones George as Managing Director, effective October 1, 2026.

The change was approved by the company’s Board of Directors on July 22, 2026, following a recommendation by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, as part of a long-term succession plan.

C J George, who currently serves as Chairman and Managing Director, founded Geojit in 1987 alongside Ranajit Kanjilal.
